events.description: The person looks at the yellow paper with a rainbow and cloud outline.
The person adjusts the yellow paper with both hands.
The person looks at the arrangement of colorful sand containers around the paper.
The person places their hands on the bottom corners of the yellow paper.
The person examines the outline on the yellow paper.
The person picks up a small white tool with their right hand.
The person uses the tool to peel off the top layer of the right cloud outline.
The person continues peeling the top layer from the rainbow and cloud outlines.
The person uses a small tool to peel off the protective layer from the right cloud of the rainbow drawing.
The person lifts the black sand container from its position on the right side of the frame.
The person pours black sand from the container onto the rainbow drawing, covering the arches and the right cloud.
The person places the black sand container back into its original position on the right side.
The person uses their hand to spread the black sand evenly across the sticky areas of the rainbow drawing.
The person rubs their hands over the black sand on the yellow paper to spread it across the rainbow design.
The person lifts the yellow paper from the right side to shake off excess black sand.
The person lifts the yellow paper from the left side to continue shaking off excess black sand.
The person shakes the yellow paper vigorously to remove all loose black sand, revealing the black outline of the rainbow.
A blue 'Subscribe!' graphic appears on the white background as the paper is moved away.
The person places the yellow paper back down, revealing the clean black sand outline of the rainbow and clouds.
The person uses a white tool to peel off the protective layer from the outermost arc of the rainbow on the yellow paper.

The person finishes pouring red sand onto the right side of the outermost arc.
The person places the red sand cup back in its original position.
The person uses both hands to lift and shake the paper to spread the sand.
The person continues shaking the paper to distribute the red sand evenly.
The person uses their right hand to peel off the next adhesive strip on the rainbow.
The person lifts the orange sand cup with their right hand.

The person lifts the yellow paper to let the excess orange sand slide down across the drawing.
The person shakes the yellow paper vertically to remove loose orange sand.
The person uses a small metal tool to peel off the protective strip from the third arc from the top of the rainbow.
The person reaches for the cup of yellow sand on the left side of the table.
The person pours yellow sand from the cup onto the newly revealed adhesive arc of the rainbow.
The person lifts the yellow paper again to let the excess yellow sand slide off the drawing.
